newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean carmaker shares fall on high inventories.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean carmaker shares fall on high inventories.

text.p: Shares of Hyundai Motor Co and two other South Korean carmakers fell in early Friday trading on worries about their rising inventories, brokers said.
Hyundai fell 500 won to 24,800, Kia Motors Corp by 200 won to 15,800 and Ssangyong Motor Co by 200 won to 5,300.
"Yesterday's news that Hyundai decided to cut production showed how serious their inventory levels are," said LG Securities broker Koh Soon-shik.
Hyundai, South Korea's largest carmaker, said on Thursday it would reduce production by four hours a day from April 8-12, largely because of rising inventory.
Other carmakers said they have no immediate plan to cut production, but industry sources say they are also under pressure from growing inventories.
